_template.title: Eligibility questionnaire step
_template.summary: Test the wording or order of the pre-screening questions that come before an application.
_template.good_for: Drop-off at the screener, people answering questions wrongly, eligible people screening themselves out.
_template.typical_change: Rewriting a question in plain language, adding an example, or splitting a compound question.

experiment.name: Eligibility screener: plainer questions
experiment.owner_team: FILL IN: which team owns the screener
experiment.description: FILL IN: the current questions, the changed wording, and why. State explicitly that no eligibility rule changes: the same answers lead to the same result, only the way the questions are asked differs.

hypothesis.statement: FILL IN: If the screener asks <question> as <new wording>, more people will finish it, without fewer of them going on to submit an application.

primary.name: screener_completion_rate
primary.definition: Share of people who started the eligibility questionnaire and finished it, counted once per person.
